marta: quick FYI: i have a small PR adding a targeted 'dedicated capacity quickstart' section. includes a tiny terraform snippet, an autoscale YAML example, a 1-line isolation hint, and a one-shot python SDK reservation example. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/601

kevin: send the branch name? i'll sanity-check terraform and autoscale.

marta: branch is docs/ded/quickstart-compact. files touched: ded/quickstart.md, snippets/terraform-ded.tf, examples/autoscale-basic.yml, sdk/python-reserve.md.

zain: ran a pass. terraform missing provider region - add `provider \"aws\" { region = var.region }`. autoscale sample should include `min_replicas` and `cooldown_seconds` for clarity. i left inline comments.

kevin: SDK nit: doc uses `reserve_capacity()` but current client exposes `create_reservation(...)`. also wrap auth/reservation call in try/except. small snippet suggestion incoming.

marta: noted. i'll update to `create_reservation`.

legal-bot: suggested SLA language: "Configurable latency SLOs; contractual SLAs are available for Dedicated customers." Avoid 'guarantee' terms.

marta: adopting legal phrasing.

zain: link issue: anchor `#autoscale-policy` collides with capacity handbook. recommend `#ded-quick-autoscale` and add redirect in docs/config/redirects.yaml. I'll paste redirect snippet in the PR description.

marta: thanks. i'll rename anchor and add the redirect entry.

kevin: proposed python snippet: ```python
from redwood.dedicated import DedicatedClient, AuthenticationError
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
try:
    r = client.create_reservation(token='rsv-123', region='us-west-2')
    print(r.id)
except AuthenticationError:
    print('auth failed')
```

marta: perfect, pushing that change now. also replaced any KMS commands with a link: "See KMS integration guide; rotate keys per org policy."

link-bot: running link-check for PR 601 (lc-2026-11-09-03).

zain: also add a single-line isolation hint: `isolation: tenant` with a link to runtime isolation page. keeps onboarders from asking in support.

marta: added isolation line and the redirect entry. pushing.

link-bot: link-check results: 1 warning (anchor rename suggested), 0 errors. zain's redirect entry applied and rechecked - clean.

kevin: approved snippets. tiny terraform comment suggested but not blocking.

legal-bot: SLA phrasing approved.

marta: merging in a few minutes and will backport to handbook branch. thanks everyone :shipit:
